evidence.observation: A speaker reports that an amount started at $25,610 and later reached $140,000 over 137 days.
evidence.quote: I started 137 days ago with only $25,610. And right now I am reaching $140,000 dollars

evidence.observation: The speaker reports earning around $1,400 every day, seven days a week.
evidence.quote: I am actually earning around $1400 on an everyday basis seven days a week

evidence.observation: Performance lyrics direct listeners to stake something and associate the invested amount with making a fortune.
evidence.quote: You've got to Stake a little something Make a fortune With what you invested

evidence.observation: Performance lyrics link lending something to receiving interest.
evidence.quote: You got to lend a little something If you wanna get a little interest

evidence.observation: A speaker reports buying BCC at approximately $1 per unit and later describing the price as more than $200 per BCC.
evidence.quote: I bought five BCC per $1 in the month of February, I think. Today, I have to pay more than $200 per BCC.

evidence.observation: The performance includes a profit claim associated with the preceding staking and lending lyrics.
evidence.quote: Make a hefty profit ride

evidence.observation: The speaker states that BCC or Bitcoin can be transferred into USD, British pounds, or euros.
evidence.quote: with your BCC or with Bitcoin you will be able to transfer it into USD, British Pound or Euro

evidence.observation: The speaker reports criticism that the activity was a con or scam and that people would lose money, while presenting that criticism within the event speech.
evidence.quote: I am saying to so many people who said that this was going to be a con artists game that this was going to be a scammer game. Hey you gonna lose all your money.

evidence.observation: Two presenters are visibly speaking on a stage with a large BitConnect logo displayed behind them.
A suited speaker is visibly addressing an on-stage group, with the BitConnect logo displayed on the screen behind them.
